mentions.name: Koaches
mentions.description: This app is an interview coaching and preparation platform that helps candidates prepare for behavioral interviews. It includes story creation, mock interview practice, and interview-specific practice, starting with behavioral interviews before expanding to other interview types.
mentions.problem: Human interview coaching is hard to scale — a coach with a full-time job can only serve one person at a time (5-10 people per year) due to logistics, interview cycles, and family constraints, limiting candidates' access to coaching.
mentions.audience: Candidates actively interviewing, initially those preparing for behavioral interviews.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I took my 10 years of coaching expertise and turned it into https://koaches.app/ which is an interview coaching and preparation platform that helps candidate prepare for their behavioral interviews which includes stories creation, mock interview practice and interview specific practice.
mentions.author: maddynator
